ticket.summary: Rename 'Basket' to 'Trip cart' in the header
ticket.description:
Marketing asked to rename the header link.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
1. The header link previously labelled 'Basket' now reads 'Trip cart' on every page.
2. The link still opens /cart.
3. The item counter badge next to the link is unchanged.

Out of scope: the checkout flow and payment pages are not touched by this ticket.
